## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the approval threshold before merge because the new comparison blocks releases that meet the configured minimum.

## Changes

The pull request regenerates the deployment catalog with production service names and ports. It also switches the service health check to a truthiness check and changes the release approval comparison.

## Critical

- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases at the approval threshold — With two approvals and the default minimum of two, `approved()` returns `False`. The `>` comparison excludes equality even though the module requires “at least the configured number of approvals.” — A release with exactly the required approvals stays blocked until an extra approval arrives. — Fix: Restore `>=` and extend `test_approved_release` to cover equality.
